explanation: Shrunk case is single body (e=1) bouncing off right arena boundary. Energy is conserved until step 137 then jumps at step 138 from ~1054 J to 1294 J (22% gain) when vx flips from +43.86 to -49.04 during boundary collision with 2 substeps. With e=1 the collision should be elastic (no gain), but semi-implicit Euler with positional correction / impulse adds spurious kinetic energy on high-speed impact, exceeding the 10%+5J energy_bound tolerance. Lowering restitution removes gain.
vision_note: Steps 135 to 137 show a single blue circle moving rightward and compressing against the right arena wall, and step 138 shows it rebounding leftward after contact. No controller body, waypoints, or wall penetration is visible, only a clean high-speed elastic bounce at the boundary.
